contenu:
name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

extends:
  template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
  parameters:
    agent_pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# common-lib-update.yml
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Single pipeline that updates @mesx/common-ui-lib across all consumer UI repos.
#
# How it works:
#   For each consumer repo listed below, this pipeline:
#     1. Clones the repo
#     2. Updates the dependency version in package.json
#     3. Runs npm install + npm run build to validate
#     4. Pushes a branch and creates a PR
#
# Trigger: manual only. Pick the repos to update from the checklist.
#
# Nothing to install in consumer repos. No config files. No extra pipelines.
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

trigger: none

parameters:
- name: version
  displayName: 'Version to update to (leave empty = latest from registry)'
  type: string
  default: ''
- name: repos
  displayName: 'UI repos to update'
  type: object
  default:
  - mesx-admin-ui
  - mesx-downtime-ui
  - mesx-leveling-board-ui
  - mesx-picking-ui
  - mesx-ume-ui
  - mesx-wk-integration-ui
  - mesx-central-error-ui
  - mesx-job-scheduler-ui
  - mesx-epart-board-ui
  - mesx-dependency-management-ui

variables:
  packageName: '@mesx/common-ui-lib'
  org: 'https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/'
  project: 'MES_X.0'

pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx

jobs:
- job: update_consumers
  displayName: 'Update Consumer UI Apps'
  timeoutInMinutes: 60
  steps:

  # ── Resolve version ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - task: npmAuthenticate@0
    inputs:
      workingFile: .npmrc
    displayName: Authenticate npm Registry

  - script: |
      set -euo pipefail

      REQUESTED="${{ parameters.version }}"

      if [ -z "$REQUESTED" ]; then
        echo "Resolving latest version from registry..."
        for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
          VERSION=$(npm view "$(packageName)" version 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          [ -n "$VERSION" ] && break
          echo "  Retry $i..."
          sleep 10
        done
      else
        VERSION="$REQUESTED"
      fi

      if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
        echo "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Could not resolve version"
        exit 1
      fi

      echo "Target version: $VERSION"
      echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=targetVersion]$VERSION"
    displayName: Resolve Version

  # ── Process each consumer repo ──────────────────────────────────────
  - task: PowerShell@2
    displayName: 'Update All Consumer Repos'
    inputs:
      targetType: inline
      script: |
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

        $orgUrl      = "$(org)"
        $project     = "$(project)"
        $packageName = "$(packageName)"
        $version     = "$(targetVersion)"

        # Consumer list comes from the pipeline parameter checklist
        $allConsumers = @(
          ${{ each repo in parameters.repos }}:
          "${{ repo }}"
          ${{ end }}
        ) | Where-Object { $_ -ne "" }

        $headers = @{
          "Content-Type"  = "application/json"
          "Authorization" = "Bearer $env:SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN"
        }

        $branchPrefix = "deps/common-ui-lib-update"
        $results = @()

        foreach ($repo in $allConsumers) {
          Write-Host ""
          Write-Host "========================================"
          Write-Host " Processing: $repo"
          Write-Host "========================================"

          $status = "unknown"
          $workDir = Join-Path $env:AGENT_TEMPDIRECTORY $repo

          try {
            # ── Clone ──────────────────────────────────────────────
            $repoUrl = "${orgUrl}${project}/_git/${repo}"
            Write-Host "Cloning $repo..."

            # Use the build service token for git operations
            $tokenHeader = "AUTHORIZATION: bearer $env:SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN"
            git -c http.extraHeader="$tokenHeader" clone --depth 1 $repoUrl $workDir 2>&1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
              Write-Warning "  Failed to clone $repo — skipping"
              $results += @{ repo = $repo; status = "clone-failed" }
              continue
            }

            Push-Location $workDir

            # ── Check current version ──────────────────────────────
            $currentRaw = (node -p "
              const pkg = require('./package.json');
              const deps = { ...pkg.dependencies, ...pkg.devDependencies };
              deps['$packageName'] || 'not-found';
            ").Trim()
            $current = $currentRaw -replace '[\^~>=<]', ''

            Write-Host "  Current: $current -> Target: $version"

            if ($current -eq $version) {
              Write-Host "  Already up to date — skipping"
              $results += @{ repo = $repo; status = "up-to-date" }
              Pop-Location
              continue
            }

            if ($current -eq "not-found") {
              Write-Host "  Package not found in dependencies — skipping"
              $results += @{ repo = $repo; status = "not-a-consumer" }
              Pop-Location
              continue
            }

            # ── Check if branch/PR already exists ──────────────────
            $branchName = "$branchPrefix/v$version"
            $branchExists = git ls-remote --heads origin $branchName 2>$null
            if ($branchExists) {
              Write-Host "  Branch $branchName already exists — skipping"
              $results += @{ repo = $repo; status = "pr-pending" }
              Pop-Location
              continue
            }

            # ── Create branch ──────────────────────────────────────
            git config user.email "azure-pipelines@faurecia.com"
            git config user.name "Azure Pipelines"
            git checkout -b $branchName

            # ── Authenticate npm & update ──────────────────────────
            # Copy .npmrc auth from the pipeline working directory
            if (Test-Path "$env:AGENT_TEMPDIRECTORY/.npmrc") {
              Copy-Item "$env:AGENT_TEMPDIRECTORY/.npmrc" .npmrc -Force
            }

            Write-Host "  Updating $packageName to $version..."
            npm install "${packageName}@${version}" --save --save-prefix='^' 2>&1 | Out-Null

            # ── Validate: build ────────────────────────────────────
            Write-Host "  Installing dependencies..."
            npm install 2>&1 | Out-Null

            Write-Host "  Building..."
            $buildOutput = npm run build 2>&1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
              Write-Warning "  Build FAILED for $repo"
              Write-Host $buildOutput
              $results += @{ repo = $repo; status = "build-failed" }
              Pop-Location
              continue
            }

            # ── Commit & push ──────────────────────────────────────
            git add package.json package-lock.json 2>$null
            git add npm-shrinkwrap.json 2>$null
            git commit -m "chore(deps): update $packageName to v$version" 2>&1 | Out-Null
            git -c http.extraHeader="$tokenHeader" push origin $branchName 2>&1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
              Write-Warning "  Push failed for $repo"
              $results += @{ repo = $repo; status = "push-failed" }
              Pop-Location
              continue
            }

            # ── Create PR ──────────────────────────────────────────
            $prBody = @{
              sourceRefName = "refs/heads/$branchName"
              targetRefName = "refs/heads/main"
              title         = "chore(deps): update $packageName to v$version"
              description   = "Automated update of ``$packageName`` from ``$current`` to ``$version``.`nBuild validated. Review and merge when ready."
              labels        = @(@{ name = "dependencies" }, @{ name = "automated" })
            } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

            $prUri = "${orgUrl}${project}/_apis/git/repositories/${repo}/pullrequests?api-version=7.1"
            $pr = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $prUri -Method Post -Headers $headers -Body $prBody
            Write-Host "  PR #$($pr.pullRequestId) created"
            $results += @{ repo = $repo; status = "pr-created"; prId = $pr.pullRequestId }

          } catch {
            Write-Warning "  Error processing ${repo}: $($_.Exception.Message)"
            $results += @{ repo = $repo; status = "error" }
          } finally {
            Pop-Location -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Remove-Item $workDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
        }

        # ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "========================================"
        Write-Host " Summary: $packageName@$version"
        Write-Host "========================================"
        $results | ForEach-Object {
          $icon = switch ($_.status) {
            "pr-created"     { "[PR]" }
            "up-to-date"    { "[OK] " }
            "pr-pending"    { "[--] " }
            "build-failed"  { "[ERR]" }
            "not-a-consumer" { "[--] " }
            default         { "[!!] " }
          }
          Write-Host "  $icon $($_.repo): $($_.status)"
        }
        Write-Host "========================================"

        $failed = ($results | Where-Object { $_.status -in @("build-failed", "clone-failed", "push-failed", "error") }).Count
        if ($failed -gt 0) {
          Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]$failed repo(s) had issues"
        }
    env:
      SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN: $(System.AccessToken)

# release-notes-v2.yml
# Reusable step template — generates and publishes MES X.0 release notes.
#
# NEW APPROACH (v2):
#   - Determines which services changed by diffing _service_versions.json between
#     the previous infra tag and the current tag (triggered on tag push).
#   - For each changed service, queries the service's own ADO repo for PRs merged
#     between the previous and current service version tags.
#   - Collects work items (Tasks / Bugs / Incidents) linked to those PRs, then
#     resolves their parent User Stories.
#   - Groups everything by service and posts a Teams Adaptive Card.
#
# Required variable groups:
#   release_notes_mes:
#     releaseNotesAdoPat              — PAT with Code (read) + Work Items (read)
#     releaseNotesTeamsWebhookUrlPpr  — Teams webhook for PPR channel  (secret)
#     releaseNotesTeamsWebhookUrlPro  — Teams webhook for PRO channel  (secret)
#     vivaEngageTenantId              — Azure AD tenant ID (Directory ID)
#     vivaEngageClientId              — App registration client ID
#     vivaEngageClientSecret          — App registration client secret  (secret, PRO only)
#     vivaEngageCommunityId           — Viva Engage community ID (from Get-VivaEngageCommunityId.ps1)

parameters:
  - name: env
    type: string
    values:
      - ppr
      - pro
  - name: mode
    type: string
    default: full
    values:
      - generate
      - publish
      - full

steps:
  - ${{ if or(eq(parameters.mode, 'generate'), eq(parameters.mode, 'full')) }}:
    - checkout: self
      clean: true
      fetchTags: true
      fetchDepth: 0

  # ── 1. Collect work items via PR diff ──────────────────────────────────────
  - ${{ if or(eq(parameters.mode, 'generate'), eq(parameters.mode, 'full')) }}:
    - powershell: |
        & '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/.devops/Get-ReleaseWorkItems.ps1' `
            -CurrentTag          '$(Build.BuildNumber)' `
            -Env                 '${{ parameters.env }}' `
            -ServiceVersionsFile '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/_service_versions.json' `
            -OrganizationUrl     '$(System.CollectionUri)' `
            -ProjectName         '$(System.TeamProject)' `
            -PersonalAccessToken '$(releaseNotesAdoPat)' `
            -OutputFile          '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json'
      displayName: Collect Work Items from PRs

  - ${{ if eq(parameters.mode, 'publish') }}:
    - task: DownloadPipelineArtifact@2
      displayName: Download Release Notes Artifact
      inputs:
        artifactName: 'release-notes-${{ parameters.env }}'
        targetPath: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes-${{ parameters.env }}'

    - powershell: |
        Copy-Item `
          -Path '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes-${{ parameters.env }}/release-notes.json' `
          -Destination '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json' `
          -Force
      displayName: Restore release-notes.json path

  # ── 2. Archive artifact for traceability ──────────────────────────────────
  - ${{ if or(eq(parameters.mode, 'generate'), eq(parameters.mode, 'full')) }}:
    - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
      displayName: Publish Release Notes Artifact
      inputs:
        targetPath: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json'
        artifact:   'release-notes-${{ parameters.env }}'
        publishLocation: pipeline

  # ── 3. Post Teams Adaptive Card ───────────────────────────────────────────
  - ${{ if or(eq(parameters.mode, 'publish'), eq(parameters.mode, 'full')) }}:
    - powershell: |
        $webhookVar = if ('${{ parameters.env }}' -eq 'pro') {
            '$(releaseNotesTeamsWebhookUrlPro)'
        } else {
            '$(releaseNotesTeamsWebhookUrlPpr)'
        }

        & '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/.devops/Publish-ReleaseNotes.ps1' `
            -JsonFilePath   '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json' `
            -Environment    '${{ parameters.env }}' `
            -ReleaseVersion '$(Build.BuildNumber)' `
            -OrgUrl         '$(System.CollectionUri)' `
            -ProjectName    '$(System.TeamProject)' `
            -PipelineUrl    '$(System.CollectionUri)$(System.TeamProject)/_build/results?buildId=$(Build.BuildId)'
      displayName: Publish Release Notes (Teams)
      env:
        ${{ if eq(parameters.env, 'pro') }}:
          RELEASE_NOTES_TEAMS_WEBHOOK: $(releaseNotesTeamsWebhookUrlPro)
        ${{ else }}:
          RELEASE_NOTES_TEAMS_WEBHOOK: $(releaseNotesTeamsWebhookUrlPpr)

    # ── 4. Tag ADO work items as delivered ────────────────────────────────────
    - ${{ if or(eq(parameters.mode, 'publish'), eq(parameters.mode, 'full')) }}:
      - powershell: |
          $data        = Get-Content '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $releasedTag = 'Released-${{ upper(parameters.env) }}-$(Build.BuildNumber)'

          # Flatten all work items from all services into a single list for tagging
          $allItems = @($data.services | ForEach-Object { $_.workItems })

          if ($allItems.Count -eq 0) {
            Write-Output "No work items to tag."
            exit 0
          }

          # Write a temporary flat JSON for Invoke-TagWorkItems
          $flat = [pscustomobject]@{
            version   = $data.version
            workItems = $allItems
          }
          $tmpFile = '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes-flat.json'
          $flat | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -Path $tmpFile -Encoding utf8

          & '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/.devops/Invoke-TagWorkItems.ps1' `
            -JsonFilePath        $tmpFile `
            -OrganizationUrl     '$(System.CollectionUri)' `
            -ProjectName         '$(System.TeamProject)' `
            -PersonalAccessToken '$(releaseNotesAdoPat)' `
            -Tags                @($releasedTag) `
            -WorkItemTypes       @('User Story', 'Bug', 'Incident', 'Task') `
            -DeliveredAtFieldName 'Custom.DeliveredAt'
        displayName: Tag Work Items as Delivered

  # ── 5. Post to Viva Engage MESX.0 community (PRO only) ───────────────────
  - ${{ if and(or(eq(parameters.mode, 'publish'), eq(parameters.mode, 'full')), eq(parameters.env, 'pro')) }}:
    - powershell: |
        & '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/.devops/Publish-VivaEngage.ps1' `
            -JsonFilePath   '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json' `
            -Environment    '${{ parameters.env }}' `
            -ReleaseVersion '$(Build.BuildNumber)' `
            -PipelineUrl    '$(System.CollectionUri)$(System.TeamProject)/_build/results?buildId=$(Build.BuildId)' `
            -CommunityId    '$(vivaEngageCommunityId)'
      displayName: Publish to Viva Engage (MESX.0 community)
      env:
        VIVA_ENGAGE_TENANT_ID:     $(vivaEngageTenantId)
        VIVA_ENGAGE_CLIENT_ID:     $(vivaEngageClientId)
        VIVA_ENGAGE_CLIENT_SECRET: $(vivaEngageClientSecret)

  # ── 6. Update User Stories to In Production (PPR only) ─────────────────────
  # Temporarily disabled — re-enable by restoring the original condition:
  # - ${{ if and(or(eq(parameters.mode, 'publish'), eq(parameters.mode, 'full')), eq(parameters.env, 'ppr')) }}:
  - ${{ if false }}:
    - powershell: |
        & '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/.devops/Update-UserStoriesToProduction.ps1' `
            -ReleaseNotesFile        '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json' `
            -OrganizationUrl         '$(System.CollectionUri)' `
            -ProjectName             '$(System.TeamProject)' `
            -PersonalAccessToken     '$(releaseNotesAdoPat)' `
            -Env                     '${{ parameters.env }}'
      displayName: Update User Stories to In Production
      continueOnError: true

# release-notes.yml
# Reusable step template — generates and publishes MES X.0 release notes.
#
# Expected pipeline variables (add to variable group 'release_notes_mes'):
#   releaseNotesTeamsWebhookUrlPpr      — Incoming Webhook URL for the internal PPR Teams channel (secret)
#   releaseNotesTeamsWebhookUrlPro      — Incoming Webhook URL for the public PRO Teams channel (secret)
#   releaseNotesAcsSenderAddress        — ACS sender address (donotreply@<id>.azurecomm.net)
#   releaseNotesAcsConnectionStringPpr  — ACS primary connection string for PPR (secret, from Key Vault)
#   releaseNotesAcsConnectionStringPro  — ACS primary connection string for PRO (secret, from Key Vault)
#   releaseNotesDistributionListPpr     — Comma-separated recipients for PPR (internal team)
#   releaseNotesDistributionListPro     — Comma-separated recipients for PRO (stakeholders / key users)
#   releaseNotesAdoPat                  — Azure DevOps PAT used to tag work items (secret)

parameters:
  - name: env
    type: string
    values:
      - ppr
      - pro

steps:
  - checkout: self
    clean: true
    fetchTags: true
    fetchDepth: 0

  # ── 1. Generate release-notes.json from linked ADO work items ───────────────
  - task: XplatGenerateReleaseNotes@4
    displayName: Generate Release Notes
    inputs:
      outputfile: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json'
      templateLocation: File
      templatefile: '.devops/release-notes-template.hbs'
      checkStage: true                       # delta since last successful run of this stage
      dumpPayloadToConsole: false
      dumpPayloadToFile: false
      replaceFile: true
      getParentsAndChildren: false
      getAllParents: true          # traverse Task→UserStory→Feature hierarchy so parent User Stories are included
      getIndirectPullRequests: false
      stopOnError: true
      considerPartiallySuccessfulReleases: false
      checkForManuallyLinkedWI: true
      # Also pull work items by WIQL so User Stories without direct commit linkage are included.
      # Fetches all User Stories, Bugs, and Incidents under MES_X.0 (any sub-area) that
      # moved to Done state since the last successful stage run.
      wiqlFromTarget: WorkItems
      wiqlWhereClause: >
        [System.TeamProject] = 'MES_X.0'
        AND [System.AreaPath] UNDER 'MES_X.0'
        AND [System.WorkItemType] IN ('User Story', 'Bug', 'Incident')
        AND [System.State] = 'Done'
        AND [Microsoft.VSTS.Common.ClosedDate] >= @Today - 30
      getPRDetails: false
      getTestedBy: false

  # ── 2. Sanitize JSON (escape backslashes that can appear in AreaPath) ────────
  - powershell: |
      $file    = '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json'
      $content = Get-Content -Path $file -Raw -Encoding utf8
      $content = $content -replace '(?<!\\)\\(?!["\\/bfnrtu])', '\\\\'
      Set-Content -Path $file -Value $content -Encoding utf8
      Write-Output "Sanitized: $file"
    displayName: Sanitize Release Notes JSON
  # ── 2a. Filter work items by type and area path ─────────────────────────────
  # Keep only User Story, Bug, and Incident types.
  # Exclude root-level items (areaPath == 'MES_X.0') not scoped to a module.
  - powershell: |
      $file        = '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json'
      $data        = Get-Content $file -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
      $allowedTypes = @('User Story', 'Bug', 'Incident')
      $beforeCount  = $data.workItems.Count
      $data.workItems = @($data.workItems | Where-Object {
          $_.workItemType -in $allowedTypes -and $_.areaPath -ne 'MES_X.0'
      })
      Write-Output "Type/area filter: $beforeCount → $($data.workItems.Count) items"
      $data | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $file -Encoding utf8
    displayName: Filter Work Items by Type and Area Path

  # ── 2b. Enrich work items with parent titles via ADO REST API ───────────────
  - powershell: |
      $file = '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json'
      $data = Get-Content $file -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json

      $base64Pat = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes(":$(releaseNotesAdoPat)"))
      $headers   = @{ Authorization = "Basic $base64Pat"; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json' }
      $orgUrl    = '$(System.CollectionUri)'.TrimEnd('/')
      $project   = '$(System.TeamProject)'

      # Collect unique IDs to look up
      $ids = @($data.workItems | Select-Object -ExpandProperty id | Sort-Object -Unique)

      if ($ids.Count -gt 0) {
          # Batch fetch parent field (System.Parent) for all work items
          $batchUrl  = "$orgUrl/$project/_apis/wit/workitemsbatch?api-version=7.1"
          $batchBody = @{ ids = $ids; fields = @('System.Id', 'System.Parent') } | ConvertTo-Json
          $batchResp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $batchUrl -Method Post -Headers $headers -Body $batchBody

          # Build id -> parentId map
          $parentIdMap = @{}
          foreach ($wi in $batchResp.value) {
              $parentId = $wi.fields.'System.Parent'
              if ($parentId) { $parentIdMap["$($wi.id)"] = "$parentId" }
          }

          # Collect unique parent IDs and fetch their titles
          $parentIds = @($parentIdMap.Values | Sort-Object -Unique)
          $parentTitleMap = @{}

          if ($parentIds.Count -gt 0) {
              $pBatchBody = @{ ids = $parentIds; fields = @('System.Id', 'System.Title') } | ConvertTo-Json
              $pBatchResp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $batchUrl -Method Post -Headers $headers -Body $pBatchBody
              foreach ($pwi in $pBatchResp.value) {
                  $parentTitleMap["$($pwi.id)"] = $pwi.fields.'System.Title'
              }
          }

          # Enrich each work item
          foreach ($wi in $data.workItems) {
              $parentId = $parentIdMap["$($wi.id)"]
              if ($parentId -and $parentTitleMap[$parentId]) {
                  $wi.parentTitle = $parentTitleMap[$parentId]
              }
          }

          Write-Output "Enriched $($ids.Count) work items, found $($parentIds.Count) unique parents"
      }

      $data | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $file -Encoding utf8
      Write-Output "Enrichment complete: $file"
    displayName: Enrich Work Items with Parent Titles (ADO API)

  # ── 2c. Filter out already-released work items ──────────────────────────────
  # Removes items that already carry a Released-<ENV>-* tag in ADO,
  # preventing accumulation across consecutive deployments.
  - powershell: |
      $file = '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json'
      $data = Get-Content $file -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json

      $base64Pat = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes(":$(releaseNotesAdoPat)"))
      $headers   = @{ Authorization = "Basic $base64Pat"; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json' }
      $orgUrl    = '$(System.CollectionUri)'.TrimEnd('/')
      $project   = '$(System.TeamProject)'
      $env       = '${{ parameters.env }}'.ToUpper()

      $ids = @($data.workItems | Select-Object -ExpandProperty id | Sort-Object -Unique)
      if ($ids.Count -eq 0) {
          Write-Output "No work items to filter."
          exit 0
      }

      # Fetch tags for all work items in batch
      $batchUrl  = "$orgUrl/$project/_apis/wit/workitemsbatch?api-version=7.1"
      $batchBody = @{ ids = $ids; fields = @('System.Id', 'System.Tags') } | ConvertTo-Json
      $batchResp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $batchUrl -Method Post -Headers $headers -Body $batchBody

      # Build id -> tags map
      $tagsMap = @{}
      foreach ($wi in $batchResp.value) {
          $tagsMap["$($wi.id)"] = "$($wi.fields.'System.Tags')"
      }

      $beforeCount = $data.workItems.Count
      # Keep only items that do NOT already have a Released-<ENV>-* tag
      $data.workItems = @($data.workItems | Where-Object {
          $tags = $tagsMap["$($_.id)"]
          -not ($tags -match "Released-$env-")
      })
      $afterCount = $data.workItems.Count

      Write-Output "Filtered out $($beforeCount - $afterCount) already-released items. Remaining: $afterCount"
      $data | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $file -Encoding utf8
    displayName: Filter Already-Released Work Items
  # ── 3. Archive artifact for traceability ────────────────────────────────────
  - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
    displayName: Publish Release Notes Artifact
    inputs:
      targetPath: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json'
      artifact: 'release-notes-${{ parameters.env }}'
      publishLocation: pipeline

  # ── 4. Distribute — Teams + Email ───────────────────────────────────────────
  - powershell: |
      $webhookVar = if ('${{ parameters.env }}' -eq 'pro') {
          '$(releaseNotesTeamsWebhookUrlPro)'
      } else {
          '$(releaseNotesTeamsWebhookUrlPpr)'
      }
      $dlVar = if ('${{ parameters.env }}' -eq 'pro') {
          '$(releaseNotesDistributionListPro)'
      } else {
          '$(releaseNotesDistributionListPpr)'
      }

      & '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/.devops/Publish-ReleaseNotes.ps1' `
          -JsonFilePath     '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/release-notes.json' `
          -Environment      '${{ parameters.env }}' `

          } elseif ($env -eq 'ppr') {

          $RetryCount = ${{ parameters.migrationWaitingRetryCount }}

            | ConvertFrom-Json

          $migrationsJobs = $resources `
              | Where-Object {
                  $_.name.EndsWith('-dbm') -and ($_.type -eq 'Microsoft.App/jobs')
              }

          Write-Output 'The following jobs will be triggered:'
          $migrationsJobs | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "- $($_.name)" }

          Write-Output 'Triggering Migration Jobs...'
          $jobExecutions = $migrationsJobs `
              | ForEach-Object {
                  $executionName = az containerapp job start `
                      -n $_.name `
                      -g $rg `
                      --query name -o tsv
                  return [PSCustomObject]@{
                      JobName = $_.name
                      ResourceGroupName = $rg
                      ExecutionName = $executionName
                  }     
              }

          Write-Output 'Start Waiting Jobs...'
          $waitingJobs = $jobExecutions `
              | ForEach-Object {
                  Start-Job -Name $_.ExecutionName `
                      -ScriptBlock { 
                          param(
                              $jobExec,
                              $delay,
                              $retryCount
                          )

                          function Get-JobExecutionStatus {
                              param(
                                  $JobExecution
                              )
                          
                              return az containerapp job execution show `
                                  -n $JobExecution.JobName `
                                  -g $JobExecution.ResourceGroupName `
                                  --job-execution-name $JobExecution.ExecutionName `
                                  --query properties.status -o tsv
                          }
                          
                          function Wait-JobCompletion {
                              param(
                                  $JobExecution,
                                  $DelaySeconds,
                                  $RetryCount,
                                  $SuccessStatus = 'Succeeded',
                                  $WaitingStatuses = @('Unknown', 'Running')
                              )
                          
                              $jobStatus = Get-JobExecutionStatus $JobExecution
                          
                              while ($WaitingStatuses.Contains($jobStatus) -and ($RetryCount -gt 0)) {
                                  Write-Output "$(Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss') - Running, remaining retries $RetryCount..."
                                  Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds
                                  $jobStatus = Get-JobExecutionStatus $JobExecution
                                  $RetryCount -= 1
                              }


                              if ($jobstatus -ne $SuccessStatus) {
                                  throw "Migration Job did not complete successfully or timed out, status: $jobStatus, remaining retries: $RetryCount"
                              }
                            
                              Write-Output "Migration Job '$($JobExecution.ExecutionName)' completed successfully !"
                          }

                          Wait-JobCompletion $jobExec $delay $retryCount
                      } `
                      -ArgumentList $_, $WaitingDelayInSeconds, $RetryCount
              }

          $waitingJobs `
              | ForEach-Object {
                  Write-Output "$($_.Name) output:"
                  Receive-Job $_ -Wait
              }

# MES X.0 deployment

This folder contains codes and pipeline to deploy MES X.0 applications in MES X.0 environment.

Resources in MES X.0 environment are application focused and depends on other resources managed in the MPX environment.

## How to publish and subscribe message to/from pubsub?

At the time being we are using MPX Azure Event Hub Namespace for pubsub Dapr component. Each pubsub topic matches an Azure Event Hub, which needs to be created in advance.

Create the Event Hub by adding a `azurerm_eventhub` Terraform resource. The naming convention is `evh-mes-<domain|usecase>-<topic>`. For example:

```terraform
resource "azurerm_eventhub" "sample_pubsub_shop_order_created" {
    count               = local.enable_sample ? 1 : 0
    name                = "evh-mes-sample-pubsub-shop-order-created"
    resource_group_name = data.azurerm_eventhub_namespace.main.resource_group_name
    namespace_name      = data.azurerm_eventhub_namespace.main.name
    partition_count     = 1
    message_retention   = 1
}
```

Each Container App that needs to subscribe any pubsub topic needs to have a dedicated **consumer group** created, whose name must matches the Container App's `appId` (value of `properties.configuration.dapr.appId` field)

Create the consumer group by adding a `azurerm_eventhub_consumer_group` Terraform resource. For example:

```terraform
resource "azurerm_eventhub_consumer_group" "sample_pubsub_shop_order_created_processor" {
  count               = local.enable_sample ? 1 : 0
  name                = local.app_id_sample_shop_order_processor
  namespace_name      = azurerm_eventhub.sample_pubsub_shop_order_created.0.namespace_name
  eventhub_name       = azurerm_eventhub.sample_pubsub_shop_order_created.0.name
  resource_group_name = azurerm_eventhub.sample_pubsub_shop_order_created.0.resource_group_name
}
```

Refer to [this article](https://docs.dapr.io/developing-applications/sdks/js/js-client/#pubsub-api) about how to publish and subscribe message to pubsub using Dapr JavaScript SDK.

## Relation with MPX core platform

MES X.0 microservices are deployed as [Azure Container Apps](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-gb/products/container-apps) in a dedicated [Azure Container App Environment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/container-apps/environment) within Model Plant X.0 core platform. The infrastructure are managed by MPX team in [mpx-infra-platform](https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/mpx/_git/mpx-infra-platform) repository.

The deployment is executed in Azure DevOps pipeline [mesx-infrastructure](https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/mpx/_build?definitionId=2594&_a=summary) using a specific SPN (Service principle) which has limited permissions to deploy applications and data-plane objects, including (but not limited to):

- In MES X.0 dedicated Azure resoruce group `rg-<subscription>-<env>-<region>-mes-01`:
  - Deploy Container Apps, Dapr components, certificates etc. in Container App Environment `cae-<subscription>-<env>-<region>-mes-01`
  - Deploy Blob Containers and File Shares in storage account `stat<subscription>mes<01|02|03>`
  - Deploy SQL Databases in SQL Server `sql-<subscription>-<region>-<env>-mes-01`

- In MPX core resource group `rg-<subscription>-<env>-<region>-core-01`:
  - Deploy secrets in Key Vault `kv<subscription><region><env>sec01`
  - Deploy Event Hubs in Event Hub Namespace `ehn-<subscription>-<region>-<env>-core-01`
  - Deploy collections in database `Mes` of CosmosDB Account `cosmos-<subscription>-<region>-<env>-core-01`

## Generate SSL certificate

In order to expose MES X.0 web interfaces and APIs securely, the container app environment must be configured with a valid SSL certificate signed by Forvia PKI. This certificate must be configured in external ingress of container app.

As operator, follow following steps to generate or update the certficate:

1. Locally generate a RSA private key and CSR.

   ```bash
   openssl req -new -newkey rsa:4096 -nodes -keyout cert.key -out cert.csr -subj "/CN=mesx.app.corp" -batch -passin pass:
   ```

2. Submit a certificate request in [PKI](https://wwgrppkiv001.ww.corp/EE/csr-fh.cgi) uploading the CSR file. Make sure enter the DL email address of operation team.

3. Once the certificate is signed, prepare certificate bundle PEM file `cert_bundle.crt` with:

   ```text
   <certificate>
   <internal_CA>
   <root_CA>
   ```

   **IMPORTANT:** Make sure the public certificates are placed in correct order

4. Generate a PFX file (You will need to provide a password when executing the command below)

   ```bash
   winpty openssl pkcs12 -export -inkey cert.key -in cert_bundle.crt -out cert_mesx_pro.pfx
   ```

5. Upload the PFX file to Azure DevOps as [secure file](https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/mpx/_library?itemType=SecureFiles). If the file exists already, delete it and upload a new one with same name.

6. Update variable `CERT_PFX_PASSWORD` in [app_cloud_pro_mes](https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/mpx/_library?itemType=VariableGroups&view=VariableGroupView&variableGroupId=486&path=app_cloud_pro_mes) with value of PFX password

7. Trigger the deployment pipeline to update the certificate

  dependsOn: deploy_ppr
  condition: succeeded('deploy_ppr')
  jobs:
  - job: generate_release_notes_ppr
    displayName: Generate Release Notes Artifact PPR
    variables:
    - template: .devops/vars_ppr.yml
    - group: app_cloud_ppr_mes
    - group: release_notes_mes
    steps:
    - template: .devops/release-notes-v2.yml
      parameters:
        env: ppr
        mode: generate

- stage: publish_release_notes_ppr
  displayName: Publish Release Notes PPR
  dependsOn:
  - deploy_ppr
  - preview_release_notes_ppr
  condition: and(succeeded('deploy_ppr'), succeeded('preview_release_notes_ppr'))
  jobs:
  - job: approve_publish_release_notes_ppr
    displayName: Manual Approval Publish PPR
    pool: server
    steps:
    - task: ManualValidation@0
      timeoutInMinutes: 1440
      inputs:
        instructions: 'Validate the deployment and approve publishing release notes for PPR.'
        onTimeout: reject
  - job: publish_release_notes_ppr
    dependsOn: approve_publish_release_notes_ppr
    condition: succeeded('approve_publish_release_notes_ppr')
    variables:
    - template: .devops/vars_ppr.yml
    - group: app_cloud_ppr_mes
    - group: release_notes_mes
    steps:
    - template: .devops/release-notes-v2.yml
      parameters:
        env: ppr
        mode: publish
